dataset: MCP Registry supply and namespace concentration, publisher-selected fields
attribution: Tanod, State of the MCP Registry, snapshot 2026-10-27

comparison.note: Different largest-15 cohorts across snapshots; these are aggregate publisher index changes, not verified newly registered or live services.

derived_namespace_concentration_bounds.method: src/mcp_namespace_bounds.py integer-balanced unknown namespace tail; cross-checked against 2026-10-23 fixture
derived_namespace_concentration_bounds.interpretation: Lower-bound HHI fell versus 2026-10-23, but this does not establish actual HHI decreased. Namespace labels are not independent supplier businesses.

limitations: Counts are from Tanod's third-party daily index of the official MCP Registry, not an independently replicated full census.
Publisher 'active' is a registry status label, NOT an online/reachable/working measurement; liveness=null.
Publisher monthly 'new_by_month' groups by latest version publish date, NOT first registration; 20,137 October entries are not proven newly created servers.
A registry entry, namespace, remote endpoint or package is not an independently verified business, active customer, installed user, MCP invocation, transaction or paying buyer.
Top-15 lower-bound HHI is not full-distribution HHI; top-15 membership can change, so the change in lower bounds does not prove true concentration changed.
No independent supplier company identities, observed usage, customer payments, AgentMine routing savings or acquisition costs are measured.
No API payments, credentials, sensitive customer data, scraping behind restrictions or public deployment.
